info.title: Bitmonie REST API Reference
info.description: Complete internal developer documentation for Bitmonie mobile apps and web frontend services. All authenticated endpoints require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`).

bearerAuth.description: Enter the Bearer token returned from login or registration.

post.description: Create a new user account. On success, returns auth token and triggers email verification code.
Authenticate user via email and password credentials.
Authenticate an existing user session using a 6-digit login PIN.

post.description: Locate user account by email and dispatch a password reset code.

post.summary: Create / Issue Crypto Card (Physical or Virtual)
post.description: Issue a new card. If the user already has a verified BVN (Tier 1), the verified BVN and KYC record are reused automatically and the BVN field in the request is optional.

amount.description: Initial funding amount in USD (must cover minimum balance)

bvn.description: Optional if user is already BVN-verified

brand.description: Card scheme / brand. Defaults to Visa.

status.description: Initial status of the issued card. Defaults to active.

charge_deducted.description: Total USD deducted from fiat balance (amount + issuance fee)

post.description: Activates an issued card (particularly delivered physical cards), setting its status to active on the card provider and optionally configuring the 4-digit transaction PIN for ATM and POS.

parameters.description: Unique card identifier (integer ID or provider card ID)

pin.description: Optional 4-digit transaction PIN for POS / ATM

last4.description: Optional last 4 digits of the card to verify ownership

post.description: Transfers funds from the primary Naira wallet into Flexi Save. Supported idempotency via header or payload.

post.description: Transfers money internally from Flexi Save into a target or auto-save account owned by the user.

get.description: Lists all Auto Save accounts and recurring plans owned by the user.

post.description: Creates an Auto Save plan. `amount` is the RECURRING instalment and is NOT charged at creation. To fund the plan immediately send `initial_deposit`, which is debited from the wallet atomically.

initial_deposit.description: Debited from the wallet at creation when > 0.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Recommended for money-moving creates (8-64 chars: letters, digits, _ - : .). Replays are safe; a deposit is never charged twice.

get.description: Retrieves single Auto Save account details, including its recurring schedule configuration and next execution.

patch.description: Updates name, target amount, frequency, deduction amount, or run times for an existing Auto Save account.

post.description: Temporarily suspends scheduled automatic deductions for the plan.
Resumes automatic deductions and schedules the next immediate run slot.
Permanently stops automatic deductions and cancels the plan. Saved funds remain in the account for withdrawal.
Makes an instant ad-hoc top-up deposit from the Naira wallet into this Auto Save account.
Withdraws funds from Auto Save back to the user's Naira wallet.

get.description: Lists all goal-oriented target savings accounts with progress, targets, and dates.

post.description: Creates a target. If `initial_deposit` (alias `amount`) is greater than 0 it is debited from the NGN wallet at creation, atomically: insufficient funds fails the whole request and nothing is created.

initial_deposit.description: Debited from the wallet at creation when > 0.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Recommended for money-moving creates (8-64 chars: letters, digits, _ - : .). Replays are safe; a deposit is never charged twice.

get.description: Calculates current target progress, percentage achieved, days remaining, and estimated completion.
Returns a breakdown of accrued balance, 2% early liquidation penalty fee, and net refund before target cancellation.

post.description: Manually deposits additional funds from the user wallet towards this target goal.
Liquidates the target before completion or maturity. Requires acknowledge_penalty: true, deducts the 2% fee, and returns net balance to wallet.
Withdraws funds with 0% penalty once target goal amount has been met or the target deadline has been reached.

post.description: Moves funds directly between two savings accounts owned by the user (e.g. Flexi Save -> Target Savings).

Get USDT EasyEarn Withdrawal Details and Losses (Option B)

post.summary: Withdraw from USDT EasyEarn Plan (Option B)
post.description: Executes partial or full withdrawal from a USDT EasyEarn plan according to confirmed Option B rules. Credits net USDT back to user wallet via Quidax and logs in transactions ledger.

amount.description: Partial amount to withdraw. Omit or pass full principal for complete withdrawal.

message.example: Withdrawal completed successfully. USDT has been credited to your wallet.
The withdrawal amount exceeds your available balance.

get.description: Returns the user's SafeLocks with `active_locks`, `completed_locks` and `total_locked_balance`. Filter with `?status=active|completed`.
Available lock durations with `interest_rate`, `min_amount` and `max_amount`.

post.description:
Debits the NGN wallet immediately and locks the funds until maturity.

The amount is first transferred at the funding provider (SafeHaven). If any local step fails afterwards, the provider transfer is automatically reversed and the wallet is left unchanged. If the provider rejects the transfer, nothing is debited. Amount must be within the plan's `min_amount`/`max_amount`.

autosave.description: Optional AutoSave config (mode, amount, percentage, frequency, goal_amount, maturity_date).

400.description: Insufficient balance, amount outside plan limits, or provider failure (type=error)

post.description: Returns the principal to the wallet minus a 1% early-break penalty when the lock has not matured. The lock becomes `broken`.
Pays principal plus interest to the wallet once the lock has matured. Repeat calls on an already redeemed lock return the earlier result.

Locks USDT for 30 days, 60 days, or 1 year (365 days). USDT is NOT taken from the NGN wallet: the principal moves from the user's Quidax USDT balance into platform escrow, so the Naira balance does not change.

The amount must be within the configured min/max and not exceed the spendable USDT balance. If the escrow transfer fails nothing is created. If it succeeds but the plan cannot be saved, the USDT is refunded to the user's Quidax account.

duration_days.description: Plan duration in days (30, 60, or 365). Defaults to 365 (1 year).

duration_months.description: Optional alternative duration in months (1, 2, or 12).

400.description: Insufficient USDT, amount outside limits, product disabled, or escrow transfer failed
